parameters: What happens here shall be kept quiet, for now.
Everyone here is familiar with the Nephilim prophecy.\! Please step into the center of the room.
What are you doing to me?!
What did you hear from the voice that called out to you?
Hatred, anger, and darkness.\! Too intense for words.\! A desire for revenge.
It was Donar himself who struck the final blow on Zanatus.\! It is only natural that the demon would burn with desire for revenge.
I see why you wanted to keep this stuff a secret...\! People would become completely unhinged if rumors spread about the return of Donar...

Diana, you can't be serious with all this.\! Are you really trying to tell me we're supposed to save the world because of some fairy tale?\! I've always made my own "fate" and I'm not planning on changing now.\! Anyone can be some sort of chosen one if they want it bad enough.\! Maybe even Jeb here.
It is quite a tall order.\! To experience such evil, assaulting one's mind, and then to accept one's fate.\! Diana, you too struggled with this, you know.
Only as long as I failed to maintain my faith...
Our new friend here is welcome among us.\! Please make this your home, and take time to reflect on what happened.\! In time, you will know what you believe.
Please excuse me... I must make a record of this...
I am sorry I pushed you into this.
I guess I can't blame you...\| this is your mission.\! It's what you have to believe...
I do believe.\! And eventually, perhaps you will too.\! Until then, we will go together.\! I am yours to unleash upon your enemies.
You've got the wrong chosen one, Diana.\! But to have you as a friend and ally would be just as good for me.
